# Release 1.2 — Equity data honesty

**Status:** Approved for freeze  
**Milestone:** `1.2`  
**Parent:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after approval. Status → GitHub only.

## Outcome

Statements and trailing valuation stop lying for a smoke-tested symbol: cash flow is cash flow, standalone and consolidated both persist when available, PEG/net-debt are honest, dividend yield is not double-scaled.

## Foundation

- [ ] Failed fundamentals/metrics sync logs a clear reason (no secrets)
- [ ] Re-sync upserts; no duplicate statement rows for the same key

## Backlog

- [ ] Cash-flow Screener lines stored as `CF`, not balance sheet
- [ ] Fetch and persist CONSOLIDATED and STANDALONE when available
- [ ] Stop storing Yahoo forward PEG as trailing; PEG null until trailing exists
- [ ] Net debt only when both debt and cash exist
- [ ] Fix dividend-yield scale (store once, format once)
- [ ] Tests for CF tag, dual basis, and null net debt

## Out of scope

Stock screener, setup docs, portfolio MTM, Strategy Lab, brokers, AI.

## Exit

One smoke symbol shows correct CF tab, usable standalone when provider returns it, and valuation without false PEG/net-debt/yield.

## Idea map

Equity honesty / data-model tighten for statements and valuation.
